sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: SmileCheck is an oral health management platform connecting patients, dentists and clinics. By using our services, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
sections.content:
• "User": any person registered on the platform
• "Patient": a user seeking dental services
• "Dentist": a registered oral health professional
• "Clinic": a registered oral health practice
• "Teleconsultation": a consultation held by video call through the platform

sections.title: 3. Registration and account
sections.content:
• Accuracy of the information provided
• Mandatory phone verification
• Responsibility for account security
• One account per person/entity

sections.title: 4. Points and rewards system
sections.content:
• XP (experience): permanent points that set your level
• Reward points: can be exchanged in the Store
• Free plan: annual reset on 1 January
• Pro/Premium plan: no reset
• SmileCheck reserves the right to adjust point values

sections.title: 5. Ratings and feedback
sections.content:
• Limit of 40 ratings per day
• Ratings must be honest and based on real experiences
• Disputes possible up to 24 h after viewing
• 3 rejected disputes result in a -5 point penalty
• Ratings can be edited up to 24 h after submission

sections.title: 6. Teleconsultations
sections.content:
• Cost: {{price}} per session
• Not a substitute for in-person emergency care
• Require a stable internet connection
• Recording not allowed without consent

sections.title: 7. Job offers
sections.content:
• Job information visible only between dentists and clinics
• Patients never have access to recruitment information
• SmileCheck is not responsible for employment agreements

sections.title: 8. Cancellations and no-shows
sections.content:
• Cancellation more than 24 h in advance: no penalty
• Cancellation less than 24 h in advance: points penalty
• Unjustified no-show: maximum penalty
• Justified absence: no penalty

sections.title: 9. Intellectual property
sections.content:
• Platform content belongs to SmileCheck
• Clinical data belongs to the respective professionals

sections.title: 10. Limitation of liability
sections.content:
• The platform facilitates the connection between users
• It does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment

sections.title: 11. Changes
sections.content: SmileCheck may change these terms with 30 days' prior notice.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.content:
Email: legal@smilecheck.pt
Address: Av. da Liberdade 123, Lisbon, Portugal

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: SmileCheck, Lda. — Tax ID: 509 123 456

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content:
• Identification data (name, email, phone, date of birth)
• Professional data (licence number, specialties — dentists)
• Health data (allergies, medication, conditions — patients)
• Usage data (appointments, points, ratings)
• Technical data (IP, device, browser)

sections.title: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.content:
• Account and profile management
• Booking of consultations and teleconsultations
• Points and rewards system
• Communication between users
• Service improvement

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.content:
• User consent
• Performance of a contract
• Legitimate interest
• Legal obligation

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
sections.content:
• Health data: shared only with the patient's dentists/clinics
• Professional data: visible according to privacy settings
• Job offers: visible only between dentists and clinics
• We never sell data to third parties

sections.title: 6. Data retention
sections.content:
• Account data: while the account is active
• Clinical data: 10 years (legal obligation)
• Usage data: 3 years after last activity

sections.title: 7. User rights (GDPR)
sections.content:
• Right of access
• Right to rectification
• Right to erasure
• Right to data portability
• Right to object

DPO contact: dpo@smilecheck.pt

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content:
• Encryption of data in transit and at rest
• Two-factor authentication
• Mandatory phone verification
• Access monitoring

sections.title: 9. Cookies
sections.content:
• Essential cookies (session, authentication)
• Preference cookies (theme, language)
• No advertising cookies

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.content: Email notification in case of significant changes.
